Spotlight on climate action

At a time of profound geopolitical and economic uncertainty, COP31 comes at a critical moment for global climate action. As countries face multiple, overlapping challenges, maintaining momentum on climate remains essential. The world cannot afford further delays when proven solutions already exist that can cut emissions, strengthen resilience, improve public health, create jobs and drive sustainable economic growth.

Climate Live Feed is your daily window into the journey from Antalya to COP31 and beyond, tracking how governments, businesses, financial institutions and communities are turning climate commitments into action. From negotiations and policy announcements to breakthroughs in finance, technology, adaptation and resilience, it brings together the latest developments shaping the global response to climate change.

Follow the latest climate news, major announcements, reports and events from the United Nations, COP31 Presidency and partners, and stay informed on the actions helping to deliver a safer, more resilient and more sustainable future.
